subject: FRANK typed multi-timescale reward-state successor

clayresearch.next_test: Cross-domain synthesis of feature-specific, distributional, homeostatic and multi-timescale hypotheses without biological overclaim.

frank.delta: Place material reward strictly after verified outcome and causal credit; self-proposal/activity gets exploration-only until independent downstream verification.
frank.next_test: H1 caller inventory plus long-horizon NAcc lesion/rescue and self-reward-poisoning episodes.

gwt.delta: Use typed tonic/value state only as one continuation/disengagement input after causal outcome closure; ignition/activity itself cannot mint reward.
gwt.next_test: Compare fixed recurrence versus outcome-gated recurrence with/without typed reward control.

emergenz.delta: Do not infer emergent value from recurrence or synchrony. Reward benefit requires intervention evidence; low RPE alone must not be classified as failed dynamics.
emergenz.next_test: Factorial lesion/rescue across reward dimensions/timescales with shuffled outcomes and broken causal identity controls.

claycode.delta: Ensure executable IR can express RewardOutcomeEvidence, typed horizons, RewardPlasticityReceipt and RewardControlReadout without semantic redesign unless compilation proves a gap.
claycode.next_test: Compile the minimal reward records/update kernel through BASE parser/IR/evaluator when those packages become executable.

hyperposition.delta: Preserve competing scalar/typed/distributional reward successors until matched evidence discriminates them; value uncertainty is not truth uncertainty.
hyperposition.next_test: Represent alternative reward models and reopen after distribution shift rather than collapsing early.

claygraph.delta: Project causal edges outcome->credit->typed reward->control->slow plasticity->reentry with dimension/horizon labels; activation remains non-authoritative.
claygraph.next_test: Dynamic H1/H2 reward-flow graph with shuffled-outcome and self-reward bypass detection.

unifieddb.delta: Persist outcome evidence, typed predictions, phasic/tonic/habituation/opponent state, plasticity receipts and compatibility projections with epochs/provenance.
unifieddb.next_test: Replay-safe schema/materialization after H1 baseline fields are frozen; UNKNOWN fields remain UNKNOWN.

harness.delta: Add explicit H1 reward baseline/caller archaeology and H2 successor differential tests; do not wait until H3 binary consolidation to discover reward-function loss.
harness.next_test: Scalar vs historical NAcc vs typed vs typed+multitimescale matched replay; self-reward poisoning; task-safety conflict; reversal/OOD; restart/resource measurements.

global_controls: reward downstream of verified outcome + causal credit
self-generated activity cannot mint material reward
verified refutation may be positive epistemic information gain
low RPE alone is not boredom or stagnation
safety/resource value remains typed and cannot be silently averaged away
reward signals never mint truth or execution authority
